title: IC Substrate Inspection - Mounds Detection on Surfscan SP7
subtitle: Post-CMP Quality Validation for 3nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Sarah Chen

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Surfscan SP7 system to detect and classify Mounds defects during post-cmp inspection at the 3nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab B to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Mounds defects that are critical to yield at the 3nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Surfscan SP7 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Surfscan SP7
- Inspection Type: IC Substrate Inspection
- Target Defect: Mounds
- Process Step: Post-CMP
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 3nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab B

This test case applies to all Surfscan SP7 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab B for post-cmp monitoring in the 3nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Surfscan SP7
Software Version: v9.2.517
Recipe: IC_SUBSTRATE_INSPECTION_3nm_POST_CMP
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (85 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Surfscan SP7 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'IC Substrate Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Mounds defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 3nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 52 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 95% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.6% for IC Substrate Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.95 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-11-29
Wafers Tested: 41
Total Defects Found: 3111
Defect Density: 990.26 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 6.4%
Capture Rate: 91.2%
Test Duration: 381 minutes
System Uptime: 97.3%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Surfscan SP7 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Mounds at the 3nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
